lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately seven vertical columns posterior to the visible gill slits. Each column contains 4 to 6 local maxima, forming a regular staggered grid pattern relative to the horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid where blobs act as central nodes within the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the flank. The most prominent ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient transition, with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and lower luminance (shadow) on the ventral-facing edge.
